content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early forecast periods, especially after sharp spikes; adjust downward bias for recent high values.
- Overestimates near the end of the 30-day window; apply a mild downward correction for final 5–7 days.
- Shows persistent lag in responding to recent price drops; delay correction until 2–3 days after the drop occurs.
- Tends to overshoot after price spikes, especially in the 10–15 day window; cap forecast at 10–15% below peak if spike > 5% above mean.
- Mean reversion is underemphasized; model should gradually revert toward 30-day moving average, especially after volatility spikes.
- Forecast error is more pronounced in low-price regimes (below 85); apply a 2–3% upward bias for prices < 85 to counteract underestimation.
